title: 第172章 风吹起了思念第171章 如影随形
content_zh:
今晨的风好像比平常凉了一些，白月早早起床，已经换上一件薄薄的白色长衫，简单扎起一个醒目的马尾辫，揣着木剑就往学校后山的花园走去。
这个时节已是深秋，曾经铺天盖地的白紫色花海，现今也变得稀稀落落的，花瓣边缘微微卷曲着，褪色的褪色，掉落的掉落，地上到处都是稀碎的花瓣片。
倒是旁边有几棵银杏树，叶子黄得正盛，风一吹，叶子簌簌地飘落，白月踩着那些落叶走过时，映入眼帘的，满眼都是金黄。
她穿过那条已经走过很多次的小径，石阶两侧的草已经枯黄枯黄的，伏倒在地面上，踩上去软绵绵的，还带着露水的潮气。远处的山脊上，晨曦刚从薄薄的雾霭后面透出来，映照得整个后山有种缥缈感。
白月走平常练习累时会蹲坐的老树下，周围都还没有人，她正想着是不是来早了，忽然听到一段极轻的调子，从不远处的一个小山坡上飘过来，声音极轻，但其中有一种悠远的意境。
她慢慢循着声音的方向走去，那声音断断续续的，调子她从未听过，给人的感觉像是这人即兴演奏的，想到哪里就吹哪里，但就在这种随性中，又有一种很深沉的东西藏在内里。
她听不出这是用什么乐器演奏的，不像是笛子的清亮、圆润，也不像是洞箫、尺八等乐器的沉稳，它是偏软的质感，清脆而又灵动的。
随着白月的走近，糅杂在风中的声音渐渐清晰起来，它好像来自山坡最高处的树上，声音中似是包含着一种萧瑟、苍凉与浓郁的思念。
她翻到不远处的一棵树上，远远望去，在那棵树上找到了一个吹奏曲子的身影。
他依旧是一头白发，发丝被微风轻轻吹起，但与以往不同的是，今天的他没有穿那件红色的外袍，反而穿着一件白色的练功服。
他背靠在一支最粗壮的枝干上，一只手随意地搭在膝上，另一只手捏着一片金黄的银杏叶，贴在唇边，吹响起悠长的调子。
他好像在发呆，但深邃的目光似乎又看得遥远，像是在看山，又像是在看云，更像是穿过了那层薄雾，看向某些他声调出流露的思念。
白月没有打扰他，只是坐她跳上的树干上静静地听着，他其实吹得很好听，她也不介意陶冶一下音乐细胞。
又一阵风飘来，在她和他之间穿梭行走着，带来了银杏叶的气息和清晨的雾。
等到调子停下来的时，柳慢慢把叶子放下，看向了白月坐的那个地方。
他其实早就知道这个小鬼头来了，只不过他沉浸在自己的曲调和念想中，还没空搭理她。
看着白月在不远处对他挥了挥手，嬉皮笑脸的，他从树干上站起，以白月都无法看透的速度，一下跃飞到她的面前。
“你有那功夫看我，不如多花些心思把你今天的基本功课做好。”
白月刚从被柳的速度震撼中回过神来，很快又恢复了正常的神色，拍了拍手上沾的树皮碎屑，嘻嘻笑着说：“基本功我每天都在练，偶尔听听曲子也不耽误什么滴。”
柳没有接她的话，他已经回到地面，把那片银杏叶轻轻放在旁边的石头上，随手抄起靠在树下的木剑，向她抛了过去。

白月伸手接住，开始了她今天的基本功练习，边练还边跟柳搭话，她觉得今天的柳好像跟平常有些不一样，那种感觉怎么说呢，就像是一个木头突然有了些人气。
“柳老师，我很好奇，我感觉你应该是有修炼过，接触过古武的人，但你每次出招、移动，从来都不会有任何气的波动，就像是一个没修炼过的普通人，但实力又肉眼可见的恐怖。”
白月给出了一个自觉很中肯的评价。
柳站在几步之外，听到她的话后，没有像往常那样在她练剑时走到她旁边纠正她，反而是短暂地停顿了一下。
content_en:
The wind seemed to be cooler than usual this morning. Bai Yue got up early, put on a thin white gown, simply tied up a striking ponytail, and walked to the garden behind the school with her wooden sword.
This season is already late autumn, and the once overwhelming sea of ​​white and purple flowers has now become sparse and sparse. The edges of the petals are slightly curled, fading, fading, and falling. There are scattered petals everywhere on the ground.
There were several ginkgo trees nearby, with their leaves in full bloom. When the wind blew, the leaves rustled down. When Bai Yue walked past those fallen leaves, everything that caught his eye was golden.
She crossed the path that she had walked many times. The grass on both sides of the stone steps was withered and yellow, lying on the ground. It was soft when she stepped on it, and still had the moisture of dew. On the ridge in the distance, the morning sun just peeked out from behind the thin mist, giving the entire back mountain an ethereal feel.
There was no one around under the old tree where Bai Yuezou would squat when she was tired from practice. She was wondering if she had come early when she suddenly heard a very soft tune coming from a hillside not far away. The sound was very soft, but there was a distant artistic conception in it.
She slowly followed the direction of the sound. The sound was intermittent and had a tune she had never heard before. It felt like this person was improvising and playing wherever he thought. But in this randomness, there was something profound hidden inside.
She couldn't tell what instrument it was played on. It wasn't as clear and mellow as a flute, nor as steady as a dongxiao, shakuhachi and other instruments. It had a softer texture, crisp and agile.
As the white moon approaches, the voice mixed in the wind gradually becomes clearer. It seems to come from the tree on the highest hillside, and the voice seems to contain a kind of desolation, desolation and rich longing.
She turned to a tree not far away, looked from a distance, and found a figure playing music on the tree.
He still had white hair, which was gently blown by the breeze, but what was different from the past was that today he did not wear the red robe, but instead wore a white training suit.
He leaned back against one of the thickest branches, with one hand casually resting on his knee. The other hand held a golden ginkgo leaf, put it to his lips, and blew a long tune.
He seemed to be in a daze, but his deep eyes seemed to be looking far away, as if he were looking at mountains or clouds, or more like looking through the mist, looking at some thoughts that were revealed in his tone.
Bai Yue didn't disturb him, just sat on the tree trunk she jumped on and listened quietly. He actually played very well, and she didn't mind cultivating her musical skills.
Another gust of wind came, shuttling between her and him, bringing the smell of ginkgo leaves and morning fog.
When the tune stopped, Liu slowly put down the leaf and looked at the place where Bai Yue was sitting.
He had actually known for a long time that this little devil was coming, but he was immersed in his own tunes and thoughts and had no time to pay attention to her.
Seeing Bai Yue waving to him not far away, with a playful smile, he stood up from the tree trunk and jumped in front of her at a speed that Bai Yue couldn't see through.
"If you have the time to look after me, why not spend more time doing your basic homework today."
Bai Yue just recovered from being shocked by Liu's speed, and quickly returned to her normal expression. She patted the bark chips on her hands and said with a smile: "I practice basic skills every day. I don't waste anything by listening to music occasionally."
Liu didn't answer her words. He had already returned to the ground, gently placed the ginkgo leaf on the stone next to him, picked up the wooden sword leaning against the tree, and threw it towards her.
Bai Yue reached out to catch it and started practicing her basic skills today. While practicing, she talked to Liu. She felt that Liu seemed to be a little different from usual today. How can I put it that way? It was like a piece of wood that suddenly had some strength.Popularity.
"Teacher Liu, I'm very curious. I feel that you must have practiced and been exposed to ancient martial arts, but every time you make a move or move, there is never any fluctuation of Qi. You are like an ordinary person who has not practiced, but your strength is terrifying to the naked eye."
Bai Yue gave a self-consciously fair evaluation.
Liu stood a few steps away. After hearing her words, instead of walking next to her to correct her as she usually practiced her sword, Liu paused briefly.
